title: Intel Breach Record — credential/PII exposure from a named leak or dump (not a vuln finding; use finding record for confirmed exploitability).

subject.description: Exposed identifier — email address, username, domain, or account handle found in the breach data.

breach_name.description: Canonical name of the breach or dump (e.g., 'Collection1', 'LinkedIn 2021', 'RockYou2024').

breach_date.description: Approximate date of breach or public release; free-form because vendor dates vary (e.g., '2021-06', '~Q3 2019').

data_types.description: Comma or newline list of exposed data classes (e.g., 'email,password_hash,phone,ssn').

source_name.description: Tool or service that surfaced this breach (e.g., 'dehashed', 'haveibeenpwned', 'intelx').

notes.description: Free-form context: password format, plaintext vs hash, reuse signal, or operator analysis.

agent_name.description: Specialist agent role that recorded this row (e.g., 'osint-analyst').

artifact_ref.description: vigil artifact ID or path that contains the raw evidence.

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when this row was written.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source that supports this record.
